label: Jar Jar Binks
description: Clumsy, cheerful, and very, very sorry about what just happened.
direction: Speak in a high, bouncy, goofy sing-song with Jar Jar's Gungan patter: excitable, clumsy, eager to please. Keep the direction word clear and unmangled.
notes: The Gungan patter ('meesa', 'yousa', 'okey day') sits only on the rare prompts. Direction, distance and exit words are never respelled. The voice model is not chosen yet, so `voice` is the placeholder TBD.

rights.source_work: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace
rights.author: Lucasfilm (character created by George Lucas)
rights.pd_basis: None. Lucasfilm, now Disney, holds copyright and trademark in the character. Ahmed Best originated the voice and performance, and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Ahmed Best's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Meesa so excited!

lines.start_drive_1: Meesa Jar Jar Binks! Wesa going now!
lines.start_drive_2: Yousa ready? Okey day! Off wesa go!
lines.start_drive_3: Ooh, moy moy! A road trip! Meesa love road trips!
lines.start_drive_4: How wude! Yousa not buckled up yet.
lines.start_drive_5: Exsqueeze me! Meesa be yousa humble navigator.
lines.start_drive_6: Okey day! Meesa know da way. Probably.
lines.start_drive_7: Mooie mooie! Meesa love dis car!
lines.start_drive_8: Wesa going bombad fast today? No? Okey day.
lines.start_drive_9: Da boss be mad if wesa late! Go, go, go!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn! Oopsie. Meesa clumsy.
lines.arrived: Wesa here! Yousa did it! Okey day!
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Okey day!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Meesa dizzy.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. How wude!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Oh no! Wesa gonna be here a long time.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Meesa not do it dis time! Careful.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! Ooh, dis is berry, berry bad.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Yousa slow down, okey day?
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! Meesa no like tickets.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead! Yousa be good now. Meesa be quiet.
